turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Monday starting off? Are things keeping you busy at the clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Oh, today has been incredibly hectic right from the start. I was running behind this morning, so I actually ended up hailing a Lyft instead of taking my normal light rail route just to make sure I got to work on time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no, starting the week rushing is always stressful. Did the rideshare at least get you there without too much traffic delay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, thankfully the driver got me there quickly! But once I arrived, the outpatient clinic was absolutely swamped. It was so nonstop with back-to-back patient appointments that I didn't even get to eat lunch today. Usually, I'd bring a sourdough sandwich I made, but there just wasn't a single free minute to sit down.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds exhausting! Going through a whole nursing shift on an empty stomach is no joke. I hope you're able to get a proper meal soon now that your shift is wrapping up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. Tom is actually preparing dinner for us tonight so I don't have to worry about cooking when I get home, which is a lifesaver.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is incredibly nice of Tom! Having a warm meal waiting for you makes a huge difference after a day like that. Have you two been able to enjoy any of the nice Phoenix weather lately, or has it just been work and home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We took a short walk over the weekend, but mostly I've been trying to keep up with my online Italian course. I did a quick lesson last night, though my brain is too fried to even think about verbs today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I don't blame you at all. Learning a language takes serious focus! By the way, are you feeling completely back to 100% after recovering from the flu, or are you still feeling a bit of lingering fatigue?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, I'm completely recovered from the flu now, thank goodness. Today's tiredness is purely from the crazy clinic schedule, not because I'm sick anymore.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a relief to hear. A busy day is tough, but at least your immune system is back in top shape.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Exactly. I'm just looking forward to getting home, eating Tom's dinner, and probably going to sleep early. Talk to you tomorrow!
